papers.title: Your battery may not be a battery
papers.summary_ko: 이 논문은 '배터리'로 분류되는 소자가 실제로는 전형적인 배터리 작동 방식을 따르지 않을 수 있다는 점을 지적하는 것으로 보인다. (제목 기반 추정)

papers.title: Site‐Preferential Trace Phosphorus Substitution Accelerates and Stabilizes the Activation of Lithium‐Rich Cathode Materials
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Lithium‐rich manganese‐based layered oxides can access both transition‐metal and oxygen redox, but activation of the monoclinic Li 2 MnO 3 component is usually sluggish and structurally unstable. Uncontrolled activation promotes irreversible lattice distortion, oxygen‐related degradation, voltage decay, and capacity loss. Here we use trace phosphorus substitution to regulate the activation pathway of a Li‐rich Mn‐based cathode. Structural, spectroscopic, microscopic, and theoretical analyses show that P tends to incorporate at Li‐layer sites near Ni‐containing local environments. This site‐selective substitution modifies the Li‐slab structure and adjacent Ni─O/O electronic environment, enabling more effective activation of the Li‐rich monoclinic component with a self‐relaxing lattice response. As a result, the P‐substituted cathode reaches a peak discharge capacity of 273.1 mAh g −1 at the 50th cycle and still delivers 270.5 mAh g −1 after 300 cycles.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬 과잉 망간계 층상 산화물 양극에서 Li2MnO3 성분의 활성화가 느리고 구조적으로 불안정한 문제를 해결하기 위해 미량의 인(P)을 site-selective하게 도입했다. P는 Ni 인접 Li층 자리에 우선적으로 치환되어 Li-슬랩 구조와 Ni-O/O 전자 환경을 조절함으로써 모노클리닉 상의 활성화를 안정적으로 유도한다. 이를 통해 P 치환 양극은 50사이클에서 273.1 mAh g-1의 최대 방전용량을 나타내고 300사이클 후에도 270.5 mAh g-1을 유지한다.

papers.title: Near‐Micron Single‐Crystalline Mn‐Rich Cathodes With Exceptional Cycling Stability
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Achieving high‐energy‐density and long‐term cycling stability in Mn‐redox‐based cathodes is a critical step toward advancing Ni‐ and Co‐free Li‐ion chemistries to diversify supply chains and lower battery costs. Here, we demonstrate an unusually high performance benchmark for Mn‐redox cathodes using near‐micron single‐crystalline δ‐phase cation‐disordered rocksalt (δ‐DRX), derived from Mn‐rich DRX, delivering ≈640 Wh kg −1 with ≈97% capacity retention over 400 cycles. The very high energy density and cycle life were achieved by using a high Mn content, to suppress oxygen redox activity, and careful control of the synthesis parameters to tune single crystal particle size. Using high‐throughput automated electron microscopy, we identify interparticle compositional heterogeneity present in the early stage of phase‐pure DRX formation as the origin of orthorhombic LiMnO 2 impurity formation during cooling, a finding that rationalizes the long high‐temperature dwell times required and the associated particle coarsening in conventional synthesis. We demonstrate that an accelerated cooling strategy kinetically suppresses localized impurity formation, reducing long high‐temperature exposure, and enables downsizing of single‐crystalline Mn‐rich DRX particles to the near‐micron regime (D50 = 1.5 µm). This work provides a mechanistic basis for particle‐size control in Mn‐rich DRX synthesis, and presents δ‐DRX as a stable, sustainable, high‐performance, Ni‐ and Co‐free cathode material.
papers.summary_ko: Ni·Co-free Mn-redox 기반 양극재의 에너지 밀도와 장기 안정성을 동시에 확보하기 위해 마이크론 이하 크기의 단결정 δ상 양이온 무질서 암염형(DRX) 구조를 구현했다. 높은 Mn 함량으로 산소 redox를 억제하고 급속 냉각 전략으로 냉각 중 발생하는 사방정계 LiMnO2 불순물 형성을 억제하여 입자를 D50=1.5 µm 수준까지 축소했다. 그 결과 약 640 Wh kg-1의 에너지 밀도와 400사이클 후 약 97%의 용량 유지율을 달성했다.

papers.title: Dendritic computation for abstract rule-based flexible decision-making
papers.abstract_en: Intelligent behavior involves flexible integration of sensory input and abstract rule knowledge. Dendritic computation has been shown to contribute to top-down modulation of sensory processing; however, whether and how it is involved in flexible cognitive processing remains to be elucidated. Combining a rule-based flexible decision-making task with in vivo two-photon imaging and optogenetics in mice, we found that within single layer 5 extratelencephalic neurons in the auditory cortex, apical dendrites preferentially encoded the inferred abstract rule and somata preferentially represented sensory stimuli, whereas choice signals were present in both compartments. Optogenetic dendritic inhibition impaired rule-dependent somatic choice coding, supporting a task-relevant integration across the dendritic and somatic compartments. These results indicate that dendritic computation in cortical neurons mediates flexible behavior.
papers.summary_ko: 대뇌 청각 피질 5층 피라미드 신경세포에서 정점 가지돌기(apical dendrite)와 체세포(soma)가 서로 다른 정보를 담당함을 두 광자 이미징과 광유전학으로 규명한 연구이다. 가지돌기는 추론된 추상적 규칙을, 체세포는 감각 자극을 우선적으로 인코딩하며, 선택 신호는 두 구획 모두에 존재한다. 가지돌기 억제는 규칙 기반 선택 코딩을 손상시켜 가지돌기 연산이 유연한 행동에 기여함을 시사한다.

papers.title: Closed-loop upcycling of residual lithium in LiFePO4 into tunable thin lithium metal electrodes
papers.abstract_en: Abstract With the rapid development of electric vehicles, massive quantities of spent lithium iron phosphate batteries are generated, creating an urgent demand for efficient and sustainable recycling. Here we show a redox mediator-assisted strategy that directly converts simulated spent lithium iron phosphate powder into thin lithium metal, reducing energy requirements and enabling regeneration of the redox mediator. The process achieves a 98% final lithium extraction and produces lithium foils with a preformed interphase, tolerating volume changes and resisting air corrosion. The recycled Li (4.14 mAh cm −2 ) enables Li | |Li cells to cycle over 1,200 h at the test condition of 1 mA cm −2 / 1 mAh cm −2 and shows stable interfacial resistance with reduced electrolyte decomposition. When paired with NCM811, the cells retain 91.4% capacity over 400 cycles at 0.2 C/0.3 C. This closed-loop process couples lithium recovery with designed electrode fabrication, providing an alternative pathway for sustainable battery recycling and negative electrode design.
papers.summary_ko: 폐 LiFePO4 분말에서 잔류 리튬을 환원 매개체(redox mediator) 보조 전략으로 직접 추출하여 얇은 리튬 금속 전극으로 전환하는 폐쇄루프 업사이클링 공정을 제시했다. 이 공정은 98%의 리튬 회수율을 달성하고, 기 형성된 계면(interphase)을 가진 리튬 호일을 생성해 부피 변화에 견디고 공기 부식에 저항한다. 회수된 리튬 전극은 Li||Li 셀에서 1200시간 이상 안정적으로 순환하며, NCM811과 조합 시 400사이클 후 91.4%의 용량을 유지한다.

papers.title: Surface carbonation governs olivine reactivity for rapid CO2 mineralization
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Ultramafic rocks are a global resource with vast potential for permanent CO 2 mineralization. However, the origin of the striking reactivity difference between Ca- and Mg-bearing olivine remains poorly understood. Here we show that this difference arises not merely from the type of cation, but more fundamentally from how these cations modulate the oxygen reactivity. Nonbridging oxygens serve as the oxygen source for CO 2 surface reactions, which in Ca-olivine reduce the Ca 2+ dissolution barrier by 60% and accelerate ion release by six orders of magnitude. The calculated apparent dissolution rate constants reproduce the experimentally observed complete conversion of Ca-olivine within hours under 1 atm CO 2 . This multiscale framework reveals how surface reactions govern silicate carbonation and provides a predictive basis for modeling and engineering large-scale CO 2 mineralization in both synthetic materials and basaltic reservoirs.
papers.summary_ko: Ca- 및 Mg-함유 감람석(olivine)의 CO2 반응성 차이가 양이온 자체보다 비가교 산소의 반응성 조절에서 기인함을 보인 연구이다. Ca-감람석에서는 Ca2+ 용해 장벽이 60% 감소하고 이온 방출 속도가 6자리수 가속되어 1기압 CO2 조건에서 수 시간 내 완전 전환이 가능함을 실험적으로 확인했다. 이 결과는 표면 반응이 규산염 탄산화를 지배하는 기전을 설명하는 다중스케일 프레임워크를 제시한다.

papers.title: Solvation‐Equilibrium Locking Enables Ultrawide‐Temperature Operation of High‐Voltage Lithium‐Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT High‐energy lithium metal batteries are promising for space, polar, deep‐sea, and other extreme environments, but their operation is constrained by temperature‐sensitive ion transport, Li + solvation, and interfacial chemistry. A solvation‐equilibrium‐locked electrolyte (SELE) is reported by combining dimethyl sulfite (DMS), a low‐freezing weakly solvating solvent, with Pyr 13 DFOB (1‐methyl‐1‐propylpyrrolidinium difluoro(oxalato)borate) as an ionic‐liquid co‐solvent. Cooperative ion–dipole and weak C–H⋯O interactions between DMS and Pyr 13 + regulate the free‐solvent reservoir, while TFSI − (bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide) and DFOB − enrich the primary Li + coordination shell. Variable‐temperature 7 Li NMR, Raman, and molecular dynamics simulations show that solvent‐separated ion pairs, contact ion pairs, and aggregates remain nearly invariant from −60°C to 60°C, unlike the strongly temperature‐responsive Pyr 13 DFOB‐free electrolyte. This locked anion‐rich solvation structure reduces solvent coordination around Li + , mitigates solvent‐derived interfacial decomposition and gas evolution, and promotes LiF‐ and borate‐rich interphases on Li metal and NMC811. Consequently, Li||NMC811 cells deliver discharge capacity at −85°C and operate up to 120°C, while pouch cells remain functional after cooling to −122.9°C. A 6.6 Ah Li||Ni90 pouch cell further achieves 565 Wh kg −1 under lean‐electrolyte conditions, establishing solvation‐equilibrium locking as a molecular design principle for lithium metal batteries operating over a broad temperature range.
papers.summary_ko: 저융점 약한 솔베이팅 용매(DMS)와 이온성 액체 Pyr13DFOB를 결합한 솔베이션-평형-고정 전해질(SELE)을 통해 -60°C~60°C 범위에서 Li+ 솔베이션 구조를 거의 일정하게 유지시켰다. 이 전해질은 Li+ 주변 용매 배위를 줄여 용매 유래 계면 분해와 가스 발생을 억제하고, Li 금속과 NMC811 표면에 LiF 및 보레이트가 풍부한 계면을 형성한다. 그 결과 Li||NMC811 셀은 -85°C에서도 방전이 가능하고 120°C까지 작동하며, 6.6 Ah Li||Ni90 파우치셀은 저전해질 조건에서 565 Wh kg-1을 달성했다.

papers.title: Rotation‐Coupled Guest Anions Stabilize Polymer Solid‐State Sodium‐Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Polymer solid‐state sodium‐metal batteries are constrained by sluggish Na + migration and unstable sodium–metal interfaces, both of which are closely associated with poorly regulated solvation chemistry. Here we report a rotation‐coupled guest‐anion strategy in a poly(vinylidene fluoride‐co‐hexafluoropropylene)‐based solid‐state electrolyte (PHSE) using Mg(OTf) 2 . Mg 2+ preferentially coordinates DMF and TFSI − , weakening Na + –TFSI − association and limiting solvent‐derived reactions at the sodium metal anode. OTf − enters the Na + solvation shell as a mobile guest anion. Its C─S rotational axis and equivalent oxygen coordination sites allow conformational rotation to synchronize with Na + hopping along polymer chains. This anchor–rotator chemistry reorganizes Na + coordination, lowers the migration barrier, and promotes an inorganic‐rich, Mg─O‐containing interphase. The optimized electrolyte enables Na 3 V 2 (PO 4 ) 3 ||Na cells to retain 94.2% capacity after 1100 cycles at 2C and supports a 94 mAh pouch cell with stable cycling. It also enables high‐voltage Na 3 V 2 (PO 4 ) 2 O 2 F||Na cells to retain 93.6% capacity after 1000 cycles at 0.5C over 2.5–4.2 V. Comparative evaluation across a total of 20 polymer electrolyte systems with varied polymer matrices and anion structures identifies anion symmetry, rotational periodicity, and finite rotational barriers as molecular criteria for designing stable polymer solid‐state sodium‐metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 폴리머 고체상 소듐 금속전지에서 Mg(OTf)2를 첨가한 PVDF-HFP 기반 고체 전해질(PHSE)을 통해 회전-결합 게스트 음이온 전략을 제시했다. Mg2+은 DMF와 TFSI-를 우선 배위해 Na+-TFSI- 결합을 약화시키고, OTf-는 C-S 회전축을 이용해 Na+ 이동에 동조하며 이동장벽을 낮추고 무기물이 풍부한 계면을 형성한다. 이 전해질은 Na3V2(PO4)3||Na 셀에서 2C로 1100사이클 후 94.2% 용량을 유지하고, Na3V2(PO4)2O2F||Na 고전압 셀에서도 1000사이클 후 93.6% 용량을 유지한다.

papers.title: Rapid Renin Angiotensin Aldosterone System inhibitor optimisation in patients with chronic kidney disease and heart failure with reduced ejection fraction using potassium binder: a randomised, double-blinded, placebo-controlled trial
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Renin-angiotensin-aldosterone inhibitors (RAASi) improve outcomes in patients with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF), but their use is often limited by hyperkalaemia in chronic kidney disease (CKD) patients. This double-blind, placebo-controlled, randomised trial evaluated whether sodium zirconium cyclosilicate (SZC) enables RAASi up-titration in HFrEF patients with CKD stages 3–5 and serum potassium of 5.0–5.5 mmol/L over 14 weeks. The primary binary outcome was defined as achieving the target dose of RAAS inhibition therapy without reaching hyperkalaemia (serum potassium ≥5.6 mmol/L) over 14 weeks or otherwise. Participants ( n = 112) were randomised 1:1 to receive sodium zirconium cyclosilicate (SZC) or placebo. The per-protocol (PP) analyses included 43 out of 53 (81%) in the SZC arm and 53 out of 59 participants (90%) in the placebo arm; the intention-to-treat (ITT) analyses included all 112. At the end of the trial, 24 of 43 participants (56%) in the SZC group achieved the target RAASi dose without developing hyperkalaemia compared with 15 of 53 patients (28%) in the placebo group (PP analysis, p = 0.006, ITT analysis, p = 0.007,). Participants in the SZC group were 3 times more likely to reach the target dose without reaching potassium 5.6 mmol/L (OR = 3.16; 95% CI 1.35–7.39; p = 0.008) than in the placebo group (ITT analysis). No significant differences in adverse events between the two groups were observed. SZC appears to safely support rapid RAASi optimisation in HFrEF patients with CKD. This trial was funded by AstraZeneca via Externally Sponsored Scientific Research grant ESR-19-20174. Trial Registration: Clinicaltrials.gov NCT05004363 and EudraCT number 2020-002946-18.
papers.summary_ko: 만성 신장질환과 박출률 감소 심부전 환자에서 포타슘 결합제(SZC)를 병용하여 RAAS 억제제 용량을 증량할 수 있는지 평가한 무작위 이중맹검 대조시험이다. SZC군은 위약군보다 과칼륨혈증 없이 목표 용량에 도달한 비율이 유의하게 높았다(PP 56% 대 28%, p=0.006). 두 군 간 이상반응 발생률에는 유의한 차이가 없었다.

papers.title: Engineered TYK2 dependence enables myeloid-selective IL-10 receptor agonism
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Interleukin-10 (IL-10) is a central anti-inflammatory cytokine that suppresses immune responses in myeloid cells but can also activate T cells, limiting its therapeutic use in chronic inflammatory diseases owing to narrow efficacy windows and dose-limiting toxicities 1–5 . Here we show that myeloid and T cells differ in their dependence on JAK-family kinase pairing for IL-10 signalling and function. We took advantage of this differential kinase dependence to engineer a tetravalent nanobody-based myeloid-selective IL-10 receptor agonist (msIL-10R agonist) that fully recapitulates IL-10’s potent suppression of monocytes, macrophages and dendritic cells while avoiding stimulation of T cells. Cryo-electron microscopy structural analysis reveals a distinct receptor cross-linking geometry of the msIL-10R agonist compared with native IL-10 family cytokines. This tetravalent architecture renders signalling strictly TYK2-dependent and highly sensitive to IL-10Rα and IL-10Rβ receptor abundance, thereby conferring selective activity in myeloid cells. This msIL-10R agonist reduces inflammation in humanized mouse models of lipopolysaccharide challenge, delayed-type hypersensitivity and colitis. A humanized version exhibits IgG-like pharmacokinetics, sustained receptor occupancy and durable myeloid suppression up to 30 days without T cell activation or haematological toxicities in non-human primates. These findings establish a geometry-based strategy for achieving cell-type-selective cytokine signalling and identify the msIL-10R agonist as a therapeutic candidate for myeloid-driven inflammatory diseases, including inflammatory bowel diseases.
papers.summary_ko: IL-10 신호에서 골수계 세포와 T세포가 JAK 계열 키나제 짝짓기에 대한 의존성이 다르다는 점을 활용해, TYK2 의존적인 골수세포 선택적 IL-10 수용체 작용제(msIL-10R agonist)를 4가(tetravalent) 나노바디 기반으로 개발했다. 냉동전자현미경 구조 분석으로 기존 IL-10과 다른 수용체 가교 형태를 확인했으며, 이 작용제는 T세포 활성화 없이 단핵구·대식세포·수지상세포의 염증을 억제한다. 인간화 마우스 염증 모델과 비인간 영장류에서 최대 30일간 T세포 비활성 상태로 지속적인 골수세포 억제 효과를 보였다.
